import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    ptr = 0
    N = int(data[ptr]); ptr += 1
    LRs = []
    for _ in range(N):
        L = int(data[ptr]); R = int(data[ptr+1]); ptr += 2
        LRs.append((L, R))
    Q = int(data[ptr]); ptr += 1
    Xs = list(map(int, data[ptr:ptr+Q]))

    order = sorted(range(Q), key=lambda i: Xs[i])
    sorted_X = [Xs[order[k]] for k in range(Q)]

    size = Q
    bit = [0] * (size + 2)

    # O(Q) Fenwick init from gaps. gap[i] (1-indexed) = sorted_X[i-1] - sorted_X[i-2] (sorted_X[-1]=0)
    for i in range(1, size + 1):
        lb = i & -i
        left = i - lb
        if left == 0:
            bit[i] = sorted_X[i-1]
        else:
            bit[i] = sorted_X[i-1] - sorted_X[left - 1]

    log_size = 0
    while (1 << (log_size + 1)) <= size:
        log_size += 1

    for L, R in LRs:
        # smallest i in [1..size] with prefix(i) >= L
        p = 0
        rem = L
        for k in range(log_size, -1, -1):
            nxt = p + (1 << k)
            if nxt <= size and bit[nxt] < rem:

                rem -= bit[nxt]

        i = a; s = 0

        if s > R:

        # smallest i with prefix(i) >= R+1

            nxt = p + (1 << k)
            if nxt <= size and bit[nxt] < rem:
                p = nxt
                rem -= bit[nxt]

        # increment gap at position a, decrement gap at position b_next
        i = a
        while i <= size:
            bit[i] += 1; i += i & -i
        if b_next <= size:
            i = b_next
            while i <= size:
                bit[i] -= 1; i += i & -i

    out_results = [0] * Q
    for k in range(Q):
        i = k + 1; s = 0
        while i > 0:
            s += bit[i]; i -= i & -i
